subject.title: chore(deps): bump actions/setup-node from 6.4.0 to 7.0.0 in the github-actions group

question: Is the existing exact-head check coverage sufficient to accept setup-node v7 in the unexercised Pages and Crabbox hydration workflows, or should those paths run before merge?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and normal checks are green, but only a repository workflow owner can decide whether direct evidence is required for the two specialized automation paths.

options.title: Run specialized workflows
options.body: Exercise a Pages build and Crabbox hydration against the PR head before merging to close the remaining automation evidence gap.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Merge with the green cross-platform CI, coverage, benchmark, and workflow-lint results while accepting the small unexercised-path risk.

recommendation.title: Run specialized workflows
recommendation.body: Exercise a Pages build and Crabbox hydration against the PR head before merging to close the remaining automation evidence gap.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository toolchain work makes steipete the best available owner for the workflow-evidence threshold.
